card.name: Small words in general explanatory prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "the", "given" or "specific" inside general web explanations, often right after "of", "about" or "in". Also sentence openers like "Now" or "How" in physics or search-engine explanations.

modes.label: The after a preposition
modes.description: The word "the" right after of, about or in, before an abstract noun in encyclopedic text.
modes.example: In the determination of<< the>> truth the most recent and acknowledged scientific methods

modes.label: Modifier before a noun
modes.description: An adjective like "specific" or "given" that comes before a noun about web pages.
modes.example: PageRank estimates the likelihood that a<< given>> page will be reached by a web user

modes.label: Sentence opener in explanation
modes.description: A question or transition word at the start of a sentence in a physics explanation.
modes.example: This is Newton's law of inertia. <<Now>> suppose that the gravity switch is turned on

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in textbook-style explanations, mostly on web search and science topics.
